summary: Verified Vercel login bug fix. Added 3 new tests to /app/backend/tests/test_workshop_api.py covering (1) /api/health returns status=ok, db=connected, admin_exists=true; (2) wrong password returns 401 with clean JSON detail 'Invalid email or password'; (3) idempotent admin seeding — 3 consecutive logins return the same admin user id (no duplicates). Full suite 17/17 passed against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All previously-verified flows (auth cookie login, /auth/me, logout, public booking create, admin list/stats/patch, auth guards on protected endpoints, invalid status 400, nonexistent booking 404) continue to pass.
critical_code_review_comments: ensure_admin_seeded() creates a unique index on users.email each call before the _admin_seeded flag guard hides subsequent calls — index creation is idempotent so this is fine, but could be moved above the cache-check for clarity.
CORS allow_origins uses a single FRONTEND_URL env; on Vercel with multiple preview URLs this may block browsers. Consider supporting a comma-separated list or regex.
Login DB failure returns 503 — good — but ensure_admin_seeded() itself is inside the try, so a transient seed failure on first login also surfaces as 503. Acceptable, worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Test bookings created with TEST_ prefixed customer_name/place fields (not cleaned up; harmless data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_workshop_api.py now covers 17 tests including health, wrong-password clean JSON, and idempotent admin seeding. Auth uses httpOnly access_token cookie (samesite=none, secure). Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_workshop_api.py -v.
rca of the issue: Original Vercel bug: startup event may not run on serverless cold starts, so admin user was never seeded and login returned 500. Fix verified: ensure_admin_seeded() is invoked lazily inside POST /api/auth/login guarded by an in-memory _admin_seeded flag and a unique index on users.email for idempotency; DB errors during login are wrapped in try/except returning 503; /api/health reports db + admin_exists for diagnostics.
